quote_last: Stone Aimes was floating through cyberspace, through the massive data pages of the National Institutes of Health. Since the Gerex Corporation had a complete clampdown on their clinical-trial results, he was attempting an end run.
title: Syndrome
author: Thomas Hoover

“Give me a second. Don’t leave without me.”
The chopper pilot looked at his watch.
quote_time_case: “Three minutes,” he said. “I’m leavin’ at one.”
title: Left Behind
author: Tim LaHaye and Jerry B. Jenkins
